channel.title: Questo — Architecture And Space
channel.description: Curated dispatches on Architecture And Space

item.title: Bio-Digital Kinetic Facades
item.description: Investigating responsive architectural enclosures: biomimetic origami kinematics, shape-memory alloy actuation, real-time daylight harvesting algorithms, and mass-timber structural integration in zero-emission civic towers.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: Closed-Loop Life Support for Mars
item.description: An aerospace systems engineering analysis of Controlled Ecological Life Support Systems (CELSS): photobioreactive oxygen recycling, graywater vacuum distillation, and carbon-negative food synthesis for planetary outposts.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: Earth-Sheltered Architecture
item.description: An architectural engineering study of bermed and subterranean structures: thermal mass flywheel dynamics, passive ground-coupling, structural waterproofing, and daylight shaft optics.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: The Rise of Timber Skyscrapers
item.description: An architectural engineering investigation into mass timber: Cross-Laminated Timber (CLT), biophilic structural acoustics, carbon sequestration metrics, and the charring physics of fire safety in ply-scrapers.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: The Architecture of Brutalism
item.description: An architectural history and structural analysis of post-war Brutalism: Le Corbusier's béton brut, monumental civic geometry, shuttering timber textures, and heroic civic optimism.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: Architectural Acoustics of Concert Halls
item.description: A spatial acoustical monograph examining vineyard versus shoebox geometries, lateral sound energy fractions, and quadratic-residue diffuser arrays in symphonic halls.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: Cyclopean Masonry & Stone Hydraulics
item.description: Structural mechanics of mortarless stone engineering: analyzing shear friction, gravity retaining kinetics, and seismic energy dissipation across millennia.
item.author: Elena Vance

item.title: The Durability of Pozzolanic Concrete
item.description: Investigating volcanic ash hydration, self-healing lime clasts in marine environments, and how ancient Roman concrete chemistry informs 21st-century low-carbon infrastructure.
item.author: Julian Mercer

item.title: Acoustic Diffusors & Schroeder Sequences
item.description: Mathematical principles of quadratic residue and primitive root diffusors, phase grating scattering, and acoustic space optimization in concert halls.
item.author: Elena Rostova

item.title: Modern Architectural Brutalism
item.description: An editorial critique and investigation into Modern Architectural Brutalism.
item.author: Elena Vance

item.title: Parametric Timber & Architectural Acoustics
item.description: An architectural monograph on cross-laminated timber joinery, robotic milling, curved acoustic baffles, and carbon-negative civic spaces.
item.author: Elena Rostova

item.title: Concert Hall Architectural Acoustics
item.description: A structural acoustics monograph on Sabine decay formulas, room mode eigenfrequencies, lateral energy fraction, and number-theoretic acoustic diffusion surfaces.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: Acoustic Geometry in Sacred Spaces
item.description: An investigation into the sacred acoustic physics of stone vaults, whispering galleries, and modernist concrete chambers which transform human speech into sublime atmospheric resonance.
item.author: Julian Mercer

item.title: Spatial Minimalism & The Void
item.description: Exploring the restorative cognitive power of empty space, daylight choreography, and unadorned limestone sanctuaries in an era of sensory hyper-saturation.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: Monolithic Brutalism in the Twenty-First Century
item.description: An investigative monograph on the enduring tectonic integrity of board-marked concrete, passive thermal mass, and why permanence matters in an age of fragile construction.
item.author: Julian Mercer

item.title: The Poetics of Concrete
item.description: A comprehensive architectural investigation into the philosophical permanence of board-marked concrete, hydraulic curing, thermal inertia, and tectonic honesty in post-war civic sanctuaries.
item.author: Julian Mercer

item.title: The Geometry of Silence
item.description: How contemporary minimalist architecture orchestrates daylight angles, natural stone mass, and unadorned spatial voids to create restorative psychological retreats from digital hyper-stimulation.
item.author: Mateo Silva
